company.name: Fruitful Day
company.shortDescription: Fruitful Day is a supplier of fruits for the workplace and homes.
company.description: Fruitful Day is a Dubai-based food and wellness company founded in 2015 that specializes in delivering fresh, high-quality fruit and healthy snacks directly to homes and offices. The company operates on a subscription-based model, allowing customers to receive curated seasonal fruit boxes on a regular basis without long-term commitments. Focused on promoting healthier lifestyles, Fruitful Day partners with local and regional farmers to source fresh produce, which is hand-picked, prepared, and delivered through its certified facilities. The platform also offers a variety of services including corporate fruit deliveries, gifting solutions, event catering, and fruit-based platters and desserts.
